name: Bayt Aladwia Pharmacy
reason: Domain is completely dead: no DNS record resolves at all (not just a server-down or blocked response). Per protocol, ran two targeted web searches for the company and for its online-ordering/app presence; both confirmed the pharmacy chain is a real, substantial business but found no live website, alternate domain, or app to rescue the gate.

name: Bayt Alebaa - بيت الإباء
reason: Direct fetch was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge (inconclusive on its own), but WebSearch corroboration confirms this is a building-materials retail/wholesale/manufacturing corporation (ceramic tiles, sanitary ware, decor) -- an explicit Gate 2 hard-fail category. Confirms the prior held-review OUT verdict.

name: Bakhashab Brothers Co Ltd
reason: Confirmed automotive distributor/dealer (ISUZU authorized dealer plus passenger/commercial vehicle distribution) -- an explicit Gate 2 hard-fail category regardless of the domain's current reachability. Confirms prior verdict.

name: BD Holding
reason: bdholding.co is a corporate 'Our Entities' portfolio page for a mixed furniture/interior holding group. A majority of its named entities are explicit Gate 2 hard-fail categories (interior-design-project firm, office-furnishings/fit-out, joinery/paneling manufacturing); the domain itself carries no product catalog, pricing, or working cart for any brand -- only leftover WooCommerce/theme CSS selectors. Confirms prior verdict.

name: Bed Quarter Company
reason: Confirmed live, real Saudi-market e-commerce store (Zid platform) selling mattresses, bed frames, pillows/cushions and bedding accessories with a 151-SKU catalog, real Saudi contact details and active social channels. Passes geography (Saudi), category (home/furniture -- bedroom/sleep), narrow-category (multi-line bedroom assortment, not a single narrow SKU type), digital channel (live cart/checkout) and scale. || CROSS-VERIFICATION (independent 2nd pass): Gate 2 and Gate 3: verified that Bed Quarter explicitly 'serves hotels, resorts and medical centers' (hybrid B2B/contract supply, which alone disqualifies) and its core is mattresses/beds/furniture/massage-chairs/recliners (durable, low-repeat), plus it runs its own manufacturing facility; the 151-SKU substantiality pass missed all three.

name: Behbehani Motors Company
reason: Confirmed automotive dealership (Porsche/Volkswagen/Skoda) plus bodyshop and car-rental division -- both automotive dealer and car rental are explicit Gate 2 hard-fail categories. Confirms prior verdict.

name: Belleza
reason: Domain does not resolve in DNS at all. Two targeted web searches for this specific Qatar beauty business found no matching company, live site, or alternate domain anywhere -- only unrelated beauty retailers surfaced both times.

name: Bin Yousef
reason: binyousef.com is the corporate site of a diversified Qatari holding group (est. 1978) whose majority of businesses are explicit Gate 2 hard-fail categories (freight/cargo logistics, real estate, facilities management, management consulting, investments, an architectural-lighting JV, marine services). It does own a fashion-retail brand and grocery/F&B brands, but those are separate operating companies not hosted at this domain, which itself has no product catalog, pricing, or cart of its own.

name: Blue Sky Company
reason: The live site is a small café whose ordering system shows non-functional placeholder content rather than a genuinely operating transactional channel -- the menu section returns 'Product Not Found,' the blog posts are literal Lorem Ipsum filler text, and the copyright is stale (2021). This fails the 'genuinely live, currently operating' bar for Gate 4 even though a generic, unpopulated add-to-cart template exists on the page.

name: Mohamed Yousuf Naghi Motors - BMW Group Importer KSA
reason: Confirmed automotive dealer/importer -- BMW Group's official importer for Saudi Arabia, with a used-vehicle listings module on the live site. Automotive dealers/importers are an explicit Gate 2 hard-fail category. Confirms prior verdict.

name: Boutiqat
reason: The operating entity behind boutiqat.com (single "a") is HQ'd in the UAE, not Kuwait; Kuwait is listed only as a branch market. This is a distinct company from the similarly named Kuwait/Hawalli-HQ'd "Boutiqaat" (double "a"). Fails Gate 1 even though it has real local Kuwait operations.

name: Bradma Group
reason: Genuinely Doha, Qatar HQ'd, but the group's three divisions are food wholesale/import/distribution (largest rice and pulses importer in Qatar), automotive spare-parts trading, and building materials for construction (electrical, plumbing, scaffolding items). All three are explicit hard-fail categories, and no direct consumer retail storefront exists on this domain.

name: Build Station LLC
reason: Live, real Arabic-language e-commerce site, but the entire catalog is lighting fixtures, electrical wiring/switches/transformers, and ceramic/porcelain tiles, i.e. building materials and construction fittings, a hard-fail category and also a narrow, low-repeat-purchase product line.

name: Cadillac Alghanim كاديلاك الغانم‎
reason: Cadillac car dealership operated by Alghanim Industries (genuinely Kuwait-HQ'd, so Gate 1 passes), which makes automotive dealer the hard-fail category regardless of the site's current reachability.

name: خطوة جمل | Camel Step
reason: Genuinely Riyadh HQ'd, real live Salla e-commerce store (cart, checkout, commercial registration 1010412094, loyalty points, shipping/returns policies) selling specialty coffee equipment and beans, a consumable F&B category with real repeat-purchase frequency, so Gates 1 to 4 pass. However the full product sitemap lists only 31 total SKUs across every category combined, meaningfully below the roughly 50-SKU substantiality floor, and there is no evidence of a companion mobile app to qualify for the app-download rescue.

name: Casa Piu
reason: The live domain is currently broken (Wix domain-connect error), so per protocol a WebSearch was run before failing on reachability alone. That search revealed the underlying business is a B2B importer/supplier of sanitary ware, tiles and kitchens for hotel, tower, palace and villa projects, i.e. a construction-materials supplier, a hard-fail category, correcting the prior "home_furniture_appliance" classification.

name: Chery Alghanim
reason: Chery car dealership operated by Alghanim Industries (genuinely Kuwait-HQ'd, so Gate 1 passes); automotive dealer is a hard-fail category.

name: Sanabel Modern Motors
reason: The company name ("Modern Motors") and domain (cheryksa.com, i.e. Chery + KSA) identify this as a Chery car dealership/distributor in Saudi Arabia, a hard-fail automotive category regardless of the site's reachability.

name: Chevrolet Alghanim شفروليه الغانم
reason: Chevrolet car dealership operated by Alghanim Industries (genuinely Kuwait-HQ'd); automotive dealer is a hard-fail category regardless of the site's reachability.

name: Circle K Alsulaiman
reason: The Saudi operating entity is Alsulaiman Group (Jeddah, founded 1983), a genuine Saudi conglomerate holding the exclusive Circle K (and IKEA) franchise rights for the Kingdom, matching the Gate 1 worked example precisely, so it passes despite the brand's US/Canadian origin. Convenience/fuel retail is an approved, high-frequency category, and Circle K's global app plus confirmed HungerStation delivery integration in Riyadh provide a real digital channel. This reverses the prior OUT verdict. || CROSS-VERIFICATION (independent 2nd pass): Gate 4: site fetch confirms a corporate/brochure site (store locator, promos, hiring) with no online ordering, cart, or app; the original pass leaned on Circle K's global app plus third-party HungerStation (inference), not a confirmed first-party live channel, and the KSA model is fuel-station-forward. Correct Saudi operator (Alsulaiman) but no qualifying digital channel can be confirmed.

name: wholefoodmarket
reason: Domain is completely dead (curl connection failure). Per protocol, a web search for the domain and for the company name found no live site anywhere, and no evidence connecting this domain to any real grocery business.

name: Coffee Complex - كوفي كومبلكس
category: coffee brewing equipment retail (home appliances, narrow)
reason: Live Saudi-registered e-commerce site, but the entire catalog is coffee-preparation EQUIPMENT only (espresso machines, grinders, roasters, ice makers, boilers, presses) - a single narrow durable-goods vertical with inherently low repeat-purchase frequency, matching the confirmed narrow-category fail pattern rather than a consumable coffee/beverage retailer.

name: Concept Combined Group
category: diversified trading / wholesale / telecom IT services conglomerate
reason: Site is Cloudflare-blocked on repeated attempts. Web search corroborates a Kuwait-HQ'd (matches row) conglomerate whose own description leads with wholesale telecom distribution and B2B IT/apps-development services, with retail showrooms serving a stated commercial/B2B clientele - a diversified trading/wholesale/services business, not a focused qualifying retail category.

name: Cozmo Group
category: entertainment / leisure (bowling and family entertainment centers)
reason: Root domain meta-redirects to a client portal revealing this is a family entertainment center chain (bowling, "Recharge" attraction) with branches in Kuwaiti malls, booking birthdays/school trips/corporate events/memberships. This is leisure/entertainment, not retail commerce in any approved category; prior categorization as "grocery" was incorrect.
